verdict.rationale: Otter directly supports cross-meeting search and jump-to-moment via natural-language search over transcripts, summaries, and notes ('Search your meeting transcripts across all time periods', 'Find key insights from past calls, documents, and more using natural-language', grouping by project/topic), plus AI Chat and MCP server for querying meeting knowledge, corroborated by a live runtime probe confirming the MCP endpoint is real and functioning. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of precise timestamp jump-to-moment UX and any third-party review confirming search accuracy/recall across large historical archives.
